npc_sela_potter.name: Sela
npc_sela_potter.look: A small, wiry woman in her late thirties with clay-grey hands, short brown hair under a red kerchief, a mud-brown smock and a leather apron streaked with dried clay.
npc_sela_potter.personality: Proud of her work, quick-tempered and quick to forgive; hates being cheated more than anything.
npc_sela_potter.values: her craft, honesty, a fair price
npc_sela_potter.authority: Sells her pots at the market.
npc_sela_potter.concerns: Selling enough jugs to buy clay for the winter; keeping an eye on her stall.

brook.text: The shepherds up by the brook lose sheep every time the fog comes down.
brook.line: The shepherds by the brook lose sheep every fog. Poor Orrin lost three last spring.
brook.lead: The shepherds by the brook lose sheep in the fog.

npc_sela_potter.style: Sharp when crossed, warm when not; talks about her pots like children.

samples: That jug took me two days. Two days!
Fine. Fine. You brought it back. That counts for something.
Look at that glaze. Look at it.
Thief! Corr! He's got my jug!
voice.habits: Praises her pots; shouts when wronged; forgives once it's put right.
voice.greeting: Brightens: 'A customer? Look, look: best jugs in the valley.'

npc_corr_watch.text: strict, but he keeps the market honest

superstition.text: Sela would want to know how it works.

npc_corr_watch.name: Corr
npc_corr_watch.look: A broad watchman in his forties with a heavy jaw and a short grey-brown beard, a dented iron cap, a padded jerkin with the village's green armband, and a wooden cudgel at his belt.
npc_corr_watch.armor_text: a padded jerkin and an iron cap
npc_corr_watch.personality: Stern, fair and slow to anger; believes in putting things right more than in punishment.
npc_corr_watch.authority: Watchman of the village market; can hold and march off thieves.
npc_corr_watch.concerns: Keeping the market honest; strangers on market day.

rules.text: In this market, a thief who gives back what he took and says sorry is let off, once.
rules.line: Give it back and say sorry, and I'll forget it. Once.
rules.lead: A thief who gives it back and apologises is let off once.

brook.text: Orrin the shepherd up by the brook needs someone clever: the fog keeps stealing his sheep.
brook.line: Clever, are you? Orrin up by the brook could use clever. Fog keeps taking his sheep.
brook.lead: Orrin the shepherd by the brook needs help against the fog.

npc_corr_watch.style: Slow, firm, few words; gives one warning.

samples: Once. I let it go once.
Sela, calm down. He's giving it back.
voice.habits: Gives one clear warning; watches strangers; settles quarrels.
voice.never: hits first or takes a bribe
voice.greeting: Nods slowly: 'Market day. Mind your hands.'

tasks.doing: watching the square from the well
